content.text:
Can you please fork this repo for me:

https://github.com/productengineered/parsely

then can you adjust the UI? It should be files on the left hand sidebar, then I want spreadsheet like rows for each jsonl in the middle pane, and I want to be able to double click on any row to open a sidebar on the right that shows the full line content in the way that the current main view shows it for a given line
Also rename the project to glade and change the logo to this image

Product currently looks great. Can you make it adopt the sparkle update infrastructure used by other apps in my \~/git. If you need me to sign in and do anything on apple connect open it in your browser and I can sign in from there

Okay, so a few feedback pieces. For starters, if a row, if a JSON L line has a timestamp property, then the timestamp should be the farthest left column. Um if the row contains natural language, like real words, if we can understand that, then those columns should be placed as far left as possible. Columns that are sparse and across the general document have few columns that have actual values should be as far right as possible. So priority should be if there's a timestamp, timestamp goes all the way to the left. Then prioritize by the highest likelihood that this property is natural language, just like all readable words. Then prioritize by things that are maybe commands
Can we also add the ability to search with the view of just one line

and for displaying timestamps in the row form can we normalize. Collapse the time staps to include only the digits that are different (if all timestamps are from same date, remove the date when you display) but then bring it back in when you double click on an indiviudal row. YOu should collapse the time stamps in the table view, but the right sidebar for a specific line should include the raw timestamp

And also, can we create a store that the app tracks globally on your computer? And what it should do is you should be allowed to rearrange via dragging the columns of the row, and then the app should remember the order that you specified for the order of the columns for any document you open that has the exact same key values for the JSON. So anytime you open up any file with the same three keys for its JSON lines, the columns should remember your organization order if you changed it before and respect that.

Just like we remember the organization of the columns, can you aslo remember the resizing of each column. then also add a button to show hidden columns in the spreadshet and the ability to right click on a cell in a column and hide it fromt he view. Should still appear when you double click in but not in the preview mode

I’ll add a column filter builder with “contains” and “equals” conditions that can be combined. You’ll be able to name and save a query, then reapply it from the top of the table in any file with the same column keys.

right clicking on the column title should also let you hide it
- you should be able to right click on any file name in the top or on the left sidebar and assign alias. That should popup a textbox that lets you specify a nickname for that file that is locally persisted on your computer
- I should be able to right click on any row and tag it with a specific color (give like 5-10 standard options in the menu, vizualize them as circles of that color then a circle with an x to remove that tag)
- Can we also enable you to filter by only your tagged rows
Searching in the json also shouldn't be immediately responsive on whats displayed. you should have to hit enter to submit that query and then it should load so that it isnt lagging the app
you should be able to shift select or cmd select rows and cmd +a to select all then right click to apply tags
Can we cache what youve tagged associaited with logs file name so that if you close and reopen a file youve tagged the hiughliughts are restored
what can we do to optimize the scroll speed to be smoother

also remove the edit button for editing the jsonl files. And remove the +/- magnify feature. and make the title button for the top of the file just text, no borader or icon. Right align the buttons for the copy to clipboard and right bar
Great. can we push all these changes and notarize and publish a first release version
